parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. You can call the ListApplication operation to query the application ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149390.html
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the elastic compute container (ECC) for which you want to reset the application. Separate multiple ECC IDs with commas (,). You can call the QueryApplicationStatus operation to query the ECC ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149394.html
parameters.help_zh: 应用下需要重置机器的eccid，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149394.html接口获取eccid
parameters.name: ecc_info

ChangeOrderId.description_en: The ID of the change process for this operation. You can call the GetChangeOrderInfo operation to query the progress of this operation. For more information, see [GetChangeOrderInfo]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62072.html）
ChangeOrderId.description_zh: 变更流程ID，调用[GetChangeOrderInfo]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62072.html）接口获取这次重置具体执行进展
